description: Raw writes to research.json / tree.gedcomx.json must go through the MCP writer tools, which validate before persisting, and raw reads (`Read|Grep|Glob`, guard_project_files.py's FILE_READ_TOOLS) must go through project_context, research_query and tree_query, because the project folder is not readable from Cowork's VM or a hosted project. The matcher must stay at least as wide as guard_project_files.py's FILE_WRITE_TOOLS + FILE_READ_TOOLS + DEVICE_WRITE_TOOLS -- it decides whether the script runs at all, so a tool the script would deny but the matcher omits is a hole the script can never close. `.*device_commit_files` (not the bare name) because Cowork namespaces it `mcp__remote-devices__device_commit_files` and the plugin cannot control the prefix; the leading `.*` makes it bind even if the matcher is applied as an anchored full match. Over-matching is safe -- the script is the precise filter. It also covers `.*research_append`, because the script routes ownership-restricted sections (see OWNED_SECTIONS) by caller identity; the matcher is part of that guardrail, not packaging detail. It also covers `Agent|Task` (guard_project_files.py's DELEGATION_TOOLS), denied for `subagent_type: "fork"`, which Cowork's Claude Code offers by default and every path we test turns off, and, from a hosted plane's main thread (GENEALOGY_HOSTED_PLANE set), for a built-in agent type (BUILTIN_SUBAGENT_TYPES), which would run a step in place of the plugin agent. The last alternative names every key of AGENT_ONLY_TOOLS, the tools the script denies the main thread because only agents hold them, and of MAIN_THREAD_DENIED, the tools it denies the main thread outright. They are named rather than matched by `.*`, because every matched call starts a python3 process. A UserPromptSubmit hook, no_project_route.py, adds one conditional sentence to each researcher message: with no project, a request to research a person goes to the research skill, and a request for the names and details recorded in a record set, with no FamilySearch person ID, goes to the search-images agent. It is silent on the hosted planes, which set GENEALOGY_HOSTED_PLANE, so its text reaches Cowork only. A PostToolUse hook, agent_relay_note.py, on Agent|Task returns tells a hosted plane's main thread (GENEALOGY_HOSTED_PLANE set) to relay an agent's text after its final --- word for word; it is silent in Cowork and Desktop. A second PreToolUse entry and a second UserPromptSubmit entry run step_gate_hook.py, the step boundary on the connector and in Cowork: UserPromptSubmit starts a turn (a hand-back, prompt text starting <agent-message or the stored prompt_id, does not), and PreToolUse on Agent|Task|Skill denies, never halts, a main-thread spawn outside the turn's step group, keeping the turn in a per-session state file. It is silent on the hosted planes, which gate in process.
